input_rule: One closed ArgumentBinding is a seed only. Its member choice cannot select, order, remove or alter any batch admission.
batch_rule: The compiler calls the incumbent admission kernel for every materialized universe binding, preserves zero-based registry order, retains admitted and refused records, and seals the complete set as one batch.
implementation_binding_rule: Every batch binds the exact observed batch contract, batch profile, adversarial registry, batch runtime, admission contract, admission profile and admission runtime bytes. These digests provide reproducibility metadata only and are explicitly unauthenticated.
future_product_rule: A later ProductManifest may reference this batch only with the complete admission denominator and explicit registered omissions; this slice creates no ProductManifest or result.
claim_boundary: The batch proves only that every admission in one registered synthetic question universe was materialized through the incumbent admission kernel in exact order and bound into one self-hashed record. It does not execute a source query, establish a result, prevent selective publication, authorize publication, prove source truth, or provide production authentication.
